column3: Gives every thing its created form and then guidance, directly extending perfected creation into purpose.
Truth's arrival from the Knower of the unseen offers only a remote backdrop to the created human.

Directly names the human's creation in the best form, closely clarifying perfected making.

Directly states the human's creation from an extract of clay and adds a measured derivation.
